versioning.convention: Product milestones: major for a new business workflow, minor for capabilities within the generation, patch for fixes, compatibility, tests and documentation. Lower components reset after each increment.
versioning.evidence: No release tags. Committed package.json versions remain 0.1.0. Dates are development dates, not evidence of production deployment.
